network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto ufficiale ARPA ricostruisce gli eventi piemontesi del novembre 2002 e le sezioni idrometriche disponibili, ma non pubblica una misura compatibile dello Scrivia ad Arquata per il cedimento censito. ARCUS non trasferisce al ponte livelli osservati in altri bacini.
network_status.summary_en: The official ARPA report reconstructs the November 2002 events in Piedmont and the available hydrometric sections, but publishes no compatible Scrivia measurement at Arquata for the recorded failure. ARCUS does not transfer levels observed in other basins to the bridge.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
